sn56.36:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, puriso yaṃ imasmiṃ jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ tacchetvā ekajjhaṃ saṃhareyya,
sn56.36:1.3: sūlaṃ katvā ye mahāsamudde mahantakā pāṇā te mahantakesu sūlesu āvuṇeyya, ye mahāsamudde majjhimakā pāṇā te majjhimakesu sūlesu āvuṇeyya, ye mahāsamudde sukhumakā pāṇā te sukhumakesu sūlesu āvuṇeyya.
sn56.36:1.4: apariyādinnā ca bhikkhave, mahāsamudde oḷārikā pāṇā assu.
sn56.36:2.1: atha imasmiṃ jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya.
sn56.36:2.2: ato bahutarā kho bhikkhave, mahāsamudde sukhumakā pāṇā, ye na sukarā sūlesu āvuṇituṃ.
sn56.36:2.6: evaṃ mahantasmā kho bhikkhave, apāyamhā parimutto diṭṭhisampanno puggalo yo “idaṃ dukkhanti” yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn56.36:3.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, “idaṃ dukkhanti” yogo karaṇīyo …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yogo karaṇīyoti.
